title: Range Rover Ready to Sell Its First Electric SUV
detail: Range Rover announced it is ready to sell its first battery-electric SUV, marking the luxury Land Rover brand's formal entry into the BEV market. The move signals that premium off-road-focused automakers are now following mainstream brands into full electrification, broadening the EV transition beyond sedans and urban vehicles.

media.caption: Range Rover's first electric SUV marks the luxury brand's entry into the BEV market
